system.description:
Spellcasting. You can cast druid spells you know.

Each time you gain a level, you choose new druid spells to learn according to the Druid Spells Known table.

You use your Wisdom modifier to cast druid spells. The DC is 10 + the spell's tier.

If you fail a spellcasting check, you can't cast that spell again until you complete a rest. If you roll a natural 1 on a spellcasting check, you can't cast that spell again until you complete penance in accordance with Gede's demands.
